data.one_liner: Converts Tokens Studio for Figma JSON exports into Flutter code and themes.
data.what_it_does: Parses design tokens from a JSON file or folder exported from Figma (Tokens Studio) and generates Flutter code, including themes, custom composition tokens, and styles like colors, typography, and spacing.
use_when: You use Tokens Studio for Figma and want to sync design tokens into your Flutter project automatically.
You need a structured way to manage design systems with support for themes, typography, and composition tokens.
avoid_when: You do not use Figma or Tokens Studio for your design tokens.
You prefer manual styling and do not want a command-line code generator for your themes.
strengths: Supports multiple themes and metadata sets.
Handles complex tokens like gradients, shadows, border radii, and math expressions.
Provides composition tokens for creating custom widgets and InputDecoration conversions.
weaknesses: Breaking changes may occur on releases lower than v1.0.0.
Some token types or CSS color spaces (like non-sRGB) have limited or no support.
data.setup_notes: Activate via 'dart pub global activate figma2flutter' and run the command against your JSON tokens file or folder.
